title: Keypresses inside Ruffle (Test Movie + Live Preview) leak to the stage (arrow keys nudge shapes / switch tools / trigger reload)
description: FIXED. Root cause: the editor registers many GLOBAL window/document keydown listeners (tool hotkeys in ToolsPanel.tsx; nudge/clipboard/arrange/F8/Delete/Enter in dispatch/keyboard.ts + 7 listeners in StageArea.tsx; zoom/panel/Test-Movie in Shell.tsx; undo/redo in hooks/useHistory.ts). None checked whether focus was inside a running Ruffle player, so keys typed into the Test Movie modal / Live Preview tab also fired authoring shortcuts (arrow=nudge, letters=tool switch, Ctrl+Z=undo) AND any resulting doc mutation re-triggered the Live Preview recompile. FIX: shared containment guard isWithinRufflePlayer(e) in packages/authoring-ui/src/dispatch/playerFocus.ts — e.target.closest('[data-ruffle-host]') with document.activeElement fallback (Ruffle listens on window so target is often window but focus is inside the player). New marker data-ruffle-host on the RufflePlayer container (packages/player/src/RufflePlayer.tsx) covers BOTH Test Movie and Live Preview (both embed it). Every global authoring keydown handler now early-returns on the guard. Deliberately did NOT stopPropagation on the player (Ruffle's own keydown is also on window — that would block the SWF). SWF still receives keys (proven). Timeline.tsx already panel-scoped (safe). Test Movie Escape-to-close untouched. VERIFY: pnpm --filter './packages/**' build => Done (all 7 packages). pnpm --filter @flash/authoring-ui test --run => Test Files 77 passed; Tests 1011 passed (0 failed, incl 6 new playerFocus unit cases). E2E (cd apps/desktop; VITE_FLASH_TEST=1 npx playwright test preview-key-isolation.spec.ts live-preview.spec.ts keyboard.spec.ts) => 3 passed: preview-key-isolation (control: 't' switches tool when editor focused; then with Live Preview ruffle-player focused 't'/arrows/'p' leave tool='selection'); live-preview hot-reload still works; keyboard.spec ArrowRight STILL fires onClipEvent(keyDown) pixelDiff 10000 with player focused (SWF key delivery intact). Files: packages/player/src/RufflePlayer.tsx, packages/authoring-ui/src/dispatch/playerFocus.ts (new) + __tests__/playerFocus.test.ts (new), dispatch/keyboard.ts, ToolsPanel.tsx, StageArea.tsx, Shell.tsx, hooks/useHistory.ts, apps/desktop/e2e/preview-key-isolation.spec.ts (new), CLAUDE.md.
